public_api: github.com/rclone/rclone/vfs/vfscommon.Options.CacheDir selects an instance-owned cache root; empty preserves --cache-dir. VFS identity includes the directory and free-space queries use that captured root. RWFileHandle.ReadContext/ReadAtContext and vfscache.Item.ReadAtContext cancel only the caller's shared-download wait, preserving peer readers and cache-owned background work; existing methods keep background-context behavior.
